name: Circuit of the Americas

highlights.name: Turn 1 climb
highlights.blurb: A blind uphill braking zone. The run to Turn 1 climbs hard enough that drivers cannot see the apex until they are committed to the corner.

highlights.name: Descent through the esses
highlights.blurb: Everything gained at Turn 1 is given straight back, dropping away through the fast esses that follow.

notes: ned10m (10 m bare-earth lidar) measures 30.9 m; the 30 m DSM products report 36-37 m because they include the Turn 1 grandstands and tower. The bare-earth figure is the racing surface, so it is kept despite disagreeing with the published 41 m.
